result.summary: The layout is broadly coherent, but the second 'Popular right now' card shows a malformed discount badge ('-0%') and its favorite button uses a different (dark, low-contrast) treatment than the identical control on the card above. Minor inconsistencies also appear in the 'Fastest near you' carousel thumbnails.

issues.description: The promo badge on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' reads '-0%', which advertises a zero-percent discount — almost certainly a data/formatting bug where a missing or zero discount value is still rendered as a badge.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, and validate the value before rendering (e.g. only show when discount > 0).

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the second popular card uses a dark/translucent circular background while the identical control on the first card uses a solid white background, creating an inconsistent look and reduced icon contrast on the busy pizza image.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (e.g. solid white circle with dark outline heart) across all restaurant cards to ensure uniform appearance and adequate contrast.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a very light, near-white background while sibling thumbnails are dark, making the white '15–25 min' badge harder to read and the card look washed out compared to its neighbours.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image overlay/gradient behind the time badge, or darken the badge text/background so it remains legible on light imagery.
